summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LATO SEGRETO 18+ Italian platform with per-model Regista controls, timed CTA funnel, and richer profile features. Backend APIs working correctly (59/60 tests passed). Frontend features tested: funnel timing (10s timed CTA + 35s envelope), per-model differentiation (3 models with different regia values and ambience opacity), mode-aware descriptions, social section positioning, and OF CTA priority. Home page regression tests confirmed Italian-only content, filters, and Sorprendimi functionality.
